reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "⚠️ Remove global-rate-limit feature (#11851) ⚠️ This removes the following configuration options: * `global-rate-limit-memcached-host` *…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The removed global-rate-limit configuration options and annotations are no longer honoured, so global rate limiting configured through them stops applying after the upgrade.
consequence.remediation: Remove the global-rate-limit-* ConfigMap options and global-rate-limit* annotations, and set up rate limiting another way before upgrading.

proposed.statement: ingress-nginx 1.12.0 removes the global-rate-limit feature. This removes the ConfigMap options global-rate-limit-memcached-host, -port, -connect-timeout, -max-idle-timeout, -pool-size and global-rate-limit-status-code, and the annotations global-rate-limit, global-rate-limit-window, global-rate-limit-key and global-rate-limit-ignored-cidrs, so these settings are no longer honoured.
